stem:
Read these sentences from paragraph 15 in the story.

I was frozen in a block of ice. I wanted to cry, but my tears were frozen, too.

Why did the author include sensory language in these sentences?

options.label: F
options.text: To show that Amy is too excited to say anything

options.label: G
options.text: To suggest that Amy feels too sad to continue her job

options.label: H
options.text: To show that Amy is too frightened to do anything

options.label: J
options.text: To suggest that Amy feels too cold to think clearly
